# Freelancer

## Summary
Someone the creator hands work to — the reel editor, the graphics person. A
bench freelancer IS a Contact; the specialization is what they are good at
(`specialties`, base Tag) and what they cost (`rateNote`).

## They are records, not users
Nothing is ever sent to a freelancer by this app. They do not log in, and the
app has no notification channel to reach them with — the matrix `Remind` block is
audited as blocked on three absent pieces (an identity concept, a
card-reachable scheduler, a notification channel). The honest affordance is the
handed-to marker on a piece plus the waiting-on view, both of which are just
state the creator reads.

## Finding worth recording
Contact's `role` (a CRM enum: decision maker, champion) and `account` link stay
empty here. That is the App 4 finding repeating on a second consumer, and two
voices asking for the same thing is the case for extracting the CRM specifics to
an extending card so the base Contact is a plain person.

## Non-goals
No invoicing, no contracts, no time tracking — a different app.
